description_en: Queries the information about MaxCompute internal tables, views, external tables, clustered tables, or transactional tables
description_zh: 查看MaxCompute内部表、视图、外部表、聚簇表或Transactional表的信息
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute get-table-info --project-name odps_project --table-name sale_detail --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTableInfo

parameters.help_en: The name of the project to which the table or view to be queried belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待查看表或视图的所属项目名称
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the schema to which the table or view to be queried belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待查看表或视图的所属Schema名称
parameters.name: schema_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the table or view to be queried
parameters.help_zh: 待查看表或视图的名称
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the table or view to be queried. Valid values:
internal: Internal table.
external: External table.
view: View.
materializedView: <props="china">Materialized view (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
<props="intl">Materialized view (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/axcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
parameters.help_zh:
待查看表或视图的类型。取值：
internal：内部表。
external：外部表。
view：视图。
materializedView：<props="china">物化视图 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
<props="intl">物化视图 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
parameters.name: type

autoRefreshEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether automatic refresh of the materialized view is enabled. This parameter is returned only when the type is materialized view
autoRefreshEnabled.description_zh: 是否开启自动刷新物化视图，当类型为物化视图时有此返回值

clusterInfo.description_en: The clustering properties. This parameter is returned only when the table type is clustered table
clusterInfo.description_zh: 聚簇属性，当表类型为聚簇表时有此返回值

bucketNum.description_en: The number of buckets in the clustered table. This is an optional field. A value of 0 indicates that the number of buckets is dynamically determined during job execution
bucketNum.description_zh: 可选字段，Cluster表的Bucket数目，0表示作业执行时动态决定

clusterType.description_en:
The clustering type of the table. MaxCompute currently supports <props="china">Hash Clustering (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/use-cases/hash-clustering)</props>
<props="intl">Hash Clustering (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/maxcompute/use-cases/hash-clustering)</props> and
<props="china"> Range Clustering (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/use-cases/hash-clustering)</props>
<props="intl">Range Clustering (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/maxcompute/use-cases/range-clustering)</props>
clusterType.description_zh:
表的聚簇（Clustering）类型，MaxCompute当前支持<props="china">Hash Clustering (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/use-cases/hash-clustering)</props>
<props="intl">Hash Clustering (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/use-cases/hash-clustering)</props> 和
<props="china"> Range Clustering (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/use-cases/hash-clustering)</props>
<props="intl">Range Clustering (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/use-cases/range-clustering)</props>两种类型

name.description_en: The name of the sort column

createTableDDL.description_en: The DDL statement used to create the table
createTableDDL.example: create table if not exists sale_detail( shop_name STRING, customer_id STRING, total_price DOUBLE) partitioned by (sale_date STRING, region STRING);

creationTime.description_en: The creation time. The time is in ISO 8601 format and in the UTC time zone
creationTime.description_zh: 创建时间。格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC

isExternalTable.description_en: Indicates whether the table is an external table. This parameter is returned only when the type is table
isExternalTable.description_zh: 是否为外部表，当类型为表时有此返回值

isOutdated.description_en: Indicates whether the data in the materialized view is invalid due to changes in the source table data. This parameter is returned only when the type is materialized view
isOutdated.description_zh: 是否因为源表数据有变化，导致物化视图数据无效，当类型为物化视图时有此返回值

lastAccessTime.description_en:
The time when the data of the table or view was last accessed. This parameter is returned only when the table is a non-partitioned table.
This data has been gradually collected since July 2023. If the table has not been accessed after the upgrade, or if it is accessed through ALGO jobs or Hologres direct read, the last_access_time cannot be collected
lastAccessTime.description_zh:
表或视图的数据最后访问时间，当表为非分区表时有此返回值。
该数据从2023年7月陆续升级采集，在升级后没有被访问过或者通过ALGO作业、Hologres直读方式访问的无法采集到last_access_time

lastDDLTime.description_en: The time when the DDL statement of the table or view was last modified
lastDDLTime.description_zh: 表或视图的DDL最后变更时间

lastModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the data of the table or view was last modified. The time is in ISO 8601 format and in the UTC time zone
lastModifiedTime.description_zh: 表或视图的数据最后变更时间。格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC

location.description_en: The external table location. This parameter is returned only when the type is external table
location.description_zh: 外部表地址，当类型为外部表时有此返回值

materializedView.description_en:
Indicates whether the table is a <props="china">materialized view (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
<props="intl">materialized view (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
materializedView.description_zh:
是否为<props="china">物化视图 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
<props="intl">物化视图 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>

name.description_en: The name of the table or view

label.description_en:
The sensitivity level label of the column. For more information, see <props="china">Label-based access control (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>
<props="intl">Label-based access control (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>
label.description_zh:
列的敏感等级标签。更多信息请参见<props="china">Label权限控制 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>
<props="intl">Label权限控制 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>

odpsPropertiesRolearn.description_en: The ARN of AliyunODPSDefaultRole in RAM. This parameter is returned only when the type is external table
odpsPropertiesRolearn.description_zh: RAM 中 AliyunODPSDefaultRole 的 ARN 信息，当类型为外部表时有此返回值

odpsSqlTextOptionFlushHeader.description_en: Indicates whether to ignore the header. This parameter is returned only when the type is external table
odpsSqlTextOptionFlushHeader.description_zh: 是否忽略表头，当类型为外部表时有此返回值

odpsTextOptionHeaderLinesCount.description_en: The number of header lines to ignore. This parameter is returned only when the type is external table
odpsTextOptionHeaderLinesCount.description_zh: 忽略表头前N行，当类型为外部表时有此返回值

owner.description_en: The account information of the owner of the table or view
owner.description_zh: 表或视图的所有者账号信息

partitionColumns.description_en: The partition column information. This parameter is returned only for partitioned tables
partitionColumns.description_zh: 分区列信息，分区表才有此返回值

label.description_en:
The sensitivity level label of the column. For more information, see <props="china">Label-based access control (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>
<props="intl">Label-based access control (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>
label.description_zh:
列的敏感等级标签。更多信息请参见<props="china">Label权限控制 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>
<props="intl">Label权限控制 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>

projectName.description_en: The name of the project to which the table or view belongs
projectName.description_zh: 表或视图的所属项目名称

rewriteEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether query rewrite through the materialized view is allowed. This parameter is returned only when the type is materialized view
rewriteEnabled.description_zh: 是否允许通过物化视图执行查询改写操作，当类型为物化视图时有此返回值

schema.description_en: The name of the schema to which the table or view belongs

size.description_en: The data size of the table. If the table is a non-partitioned table, the value is the data size of the table. If the table is a partitioned table, the system does not calculate the data size of the table, and the value is NULL. The PARTITIONS view contains the data size of each partition in the partitioned table. Unit: bytes
size.description_zh: 如果表为非分区表，值为表的数据量大小。如果表为分区表，系统不会计算表的数据量大小，值为NULL。PARTITIONS视图中包含分区表各个分区的数据量大小。单位：字节（Byte）

storageHandler.description_en: The external table parser. This parameter is returned only when the type is external table
storageHandler.description_zh: 外部表解析器，当类型为外部表时有此返回值

tableLabel.description_en:
The sensitivity level label of the table. For more information, see <props="china">Label-based access control (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>
<props="intl">Label-based access control (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>
tableLabel.description_zh:
表的敏感等级标签。更多信息请参见<props="china">Label权限控制 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>
<props="intl">Label权限控制 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>

tablesotreTableName.description_en: The name of the Tablestore table to be accessed. This parameter is returned only when the type is external table
tablesotreTableName.description_zh: 需要访问的 Tablestore 表名称，当类型为外部表时有此返回值

tablestoreColumnsMapping.description_en: The columns of the Tablestore table to be accessed by MaxCompute, including the primary key columns and attribute columns. This parameter is returned only when the type is external table
tablestoreColumnsMapping.description_zh: 描述 MaxCompute 将访问的 Tablestore 表的列，包括主键和属性列，当类型为外部表时有此返回值

type.description_en:
The type of the table or view. Valid values:
internal: Internal table.
external: External table.
view: View.
materializedView: <props="china">Materialized view (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
<props="intl">Materialized view (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
type.description_zh:
表或视图类型。取值：
internal：内部表。
external：外部表。
view：视图。
materializedView：<props="china">物化视图 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
<props="intl">物化视图 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>

viewText.description_en: The statement used to create the view. This parameter is returned only when the type is view
viewText.description_zh: 生成视图的语句，当类型为视图时有此返回值
viewText.example: select shop_name, sum(total_price) from sale_detail group by shop_name
